bottom_line: Lovastatin vs placebo reduced first acute major coronary events (RR, 0.63; 95% CI, 0.50-0.79).
implications: In this trial population, the reported numbers support that lovastatin (20-40 mg/d) vs placebo reduced the incidence of a first acute major coronary event (RR, 0.63; 95% CI, 0.50-0.79) over an average 5.2 years, with similar overall mortality (80 vs 77 deaths) and similar rates of serious adverse experiences (34.2% vs 34.1%). These results do not establish effects on cardiovascular or CHD mortality because the document states there were too few events and that the study was not adequately powered for these end points.

major_points.text: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled primary prevention trial in outpatient clinics in Texas.
major_points.quote:
Design.—A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial.
                Setting.—Outpatient clinics in Texas.

major_points.text: Participants were men and postmenopausal women without clinically evident atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease and with average TC/LDL-C and below-average HDL-C.
major_points.quote:
men and women without clinically evident atherosclerotic
            cardiovascular disease with average total cholesterol (TC) and LDL-C levels and
            below-average high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (HDL-C) levels.

major_points.text: Intervention was lovastatin 20-40 mg daily vs placebo, with diet counseling; lovastatin could be titrated to 40 mg/d based on LDL-C.
major_points.quote:
Participants in the lovas-
            tatin group were titrated to 40 mg/d if
            their LDL-C level was more than 2.84
            mmol/L (110 mg/dL) at the 3-month study
            visit.

major_points.text: Primary endpoint was first acute major coronary event (fatal/nonfatal MI, unstable angina, or sudden cardiac death).

            myocardial infarction, unstable angina, or
            sudden cardiac death.

major_points.text: Lovastatin reduced the primary endpoint versus placebo: 183 vs 116 first events; RR 0.63 (95% CI 0.50-0.79).
